## Angular Notification Component

The [Kendo UI for Angular Notification](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/notification) component displays a brief message to inform users about the status of a particular process, such as a successful update of data or an error message.

## Key Features

Among the many features which the Kendo UI for Angular Notification delivers are:

* [Types](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/notification/types)&mdash;The Notification component provides several built-in types that enable you to configure colors and styles for the most common scenarios like success, info, error, warning, and more.
* [Animations](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/notification/animations)&mdash;Allows you to use different built-in animation effects, which enable you to visualize the display and disappearance of the notifications.
* [Controlling the Content](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/notification/content)&mdash;The Notification provides options for controlling its content.
* [Positioning](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/notification/positioning)&mdash;Enables you to configure the notification to align to the browser's viewport or position the component to a specific container.
* [Hiding](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/notification/hiding-notifications)&mdash;Allows you to hide the Notification by defining a delay period before the hiding occurs or by defining a closable Notification component.
* [Appending to Dynamic Containers](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/notification/dynamic-containers)&mdash;The Notification component provides a service, that can be used to define a container to which the Notification will be appended.
